messages:
harper: hi team, onboarding question - trying to list pods in `observability` namespace but getting an RBAC error. i'm guessing i need a namespace-scoped binding. can someone point me to the correct owner?
harper: error: `Error from server (Forbidden): pods is forbidden: User "harper@redwood.com" cannot list resource "pods" in API group "" in the namespace "observability"`
devops: welcome! quick diagnostics: `kubectl config view --minify` and `kubectl auth can-i list pods --namespace=observability` please. also, do you have SSO group memberships yet?
harper: `kubectl config view --minify` shows user `harper@redwood.com` and context `staging-harper`
harper: `kubectl auth can-i list pods --namespace=observability` -> `no`
kevin: observability is split between eng-observability and platform-infra. If youre on platform team, you get `platform-infra-devs`, otherwise eng-observability. What's your team?
harper: i'm on platform infra (platform-infra). my SSO should reflect that but maybe group mapping didn't happen yet.
kevin: cool. i'll create a temp RoleBinding `rb-onboard-harper-obsv` with `view` role for 12 hours. if you need to run logs (pods/log) we can add `get` on pods/logs too.
kevin: command i ran:
```
kubectl create rolebinding rb-onboard-harper-obsv -n observability --clusterrole=view --user=harper@redwood.com --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -
```
kevin: applied. should be immediate.
onboard-bot: Reminder: persistent access should be requested via the infra access form: https://internal.redwood/infra/access - picks up team group automatically.
harper: retrying `kubectl get pods -n observability` now -> shows pods, thanks! :thumbsup:
harper: one more question: when i run `kubectl logs -n observability <pod>` i get `Forbidden` on logs but pods list works. any idea?
devops: logs require `get` on pods/logs subresource; `view` sometimes covers it but not always depending on the cluster Role definitions. kevin, can you check?
kevin: i added a Role with explicit `get` for `pods/log` and bound it to harper:
```
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: onboard-harper-logs
  namespace: observability
rules:
- apiGroups: [""]
  resources: ["pods/log"]
  verbs: ["get"]
```
kevin: applied Role and RoleBinding. retry logs.
harper: logs work now, awesome. thanks.
harper: last onboarding note - is there a recommended way to separate kubeconfigs for stage/prod so i don't accidentally apply to prod?
devops: best practice: keep separate files and use `KUBECONFIG` env var when you need to merge, otherwise keep a single default. set `kubectl config set-context --current --namespace=observability` for convenience. also add a PS1 snippet with `kubectl config current-context`.
harper: perfect. adding to my checklist. thanks all!
